source_name: ATMIA showrooms – vendor profiles (NCR Atleos, Auriga)
why_relevant: Industry-association vendor showroom pages carry vendor-supplied capability and customer claims, and the ATMIA membership roster itself is an actor-map source for who is active in CEE self-service.

source_name: Auriga S.p.A. – news & media / press release section
why_relevant: Auriga (WWS multivendor ATM software) publishes named bank wins in its press-release section; it is a direct competitor/partner in CEE self-service software, so any CZ customer would surface here first.

source_name: Monet+ a.s. – company profile on Czech Digital Solutions catalogue
why_relevant: State-backed export/vendor catalogue profile of Monet+ (digital identity and electronic payment transactions for banks). Such catalogues carry vendor self-descriptions and sometimes reference customers, and the catalogue as a whole is an actor-map source for CZ fintech/payment vendors.

source_name: CzechCrunch – Czech tech/business news (vendor revenue and client disclosures)
why_relevant: Czech tech-business outlet that reports vendor revenues and strategy with client colour (e.g. Cleverlance's revenue and market direction). Useful for sizing a vendor's CZ banking exposure when the vendor itself gives no contract values.

source_name: Comgate – 'Napsali o nás' (press mentions) and blog
why_relevant: CZ payment provider's own press-mention and blog pages, where merchant wins, bank cooperations and terminal-estate claims are published. The 'napsali o nás' pattern is a common Czech vendor page type that doubles as a pointer to media coverage.

source_name: Dotykačka – payment terminal partner/integration pages (Ingenico, Verifone drivers)
why_relevant: POS-software vendor pages listing which acquirers and terminal brands are supported (Adyen, Comgate, Česká spořitelna/Global Payments, ČSOB, Fio, FiskalPRO, KB SmartPay, MONETA, Raiffeisenbank, SumUp, Teya, UniCredit per search summary). Integration/driver catalogues are an indirect but reliable map of the live CZ acquirer-terminal matrix.

source_name: MONETA Money Bank – Tiskové zprávy (bank-side confirmation of vendor deals)
why_relevant: Bank press rooms are the counterpart confirmation for vendor win claims — a vendor 'selected by' claim gains credibility when the bank issues a matching release (e.g. new payment features launched in Smart Banka). Also used to date deployments.

source_name: Peníze.cz – Tiskové zprávy (open PR republication channel)
why_relevant: Czech finance portal that republishes vendor and bank press releases verbatim in a dated, indexable feed. A low-friction way to catch CZ vendor announcements that are otherwise buried on ASPX corporate sites.

source_name: Kurzy.cz / rejstrik-firem.kurzy.cz – company register + syndicated PR
why_relevant: Combines a Czech company-register mirror (IČO, statistical data — Printec Czech Republic s.r.o. IČO 28886755) with a syndicated news/PR stream. Lets vendor claims be tied to a legal entity and to filed financials, which is how a 'win' claim gets sanity-checked without contract disclosure.

source_name: GLEIF/LEI record – PRINTEC CZECH REPUBLIC, s.r.o. (LEI 315700WPP875AAWQY969)
why_relevant: LEI records give authoritative legal-entity identity and parent relationships for vendors, which is the disambiguation layer needed when the same integrator announces wins under several national entities.

source_name: Thales (Gemalto) – Banking & Payment press releases and solutions catalogue
why_relevant: Publication point for card-issuance, instant-issuance and digital-first card wins. Thales names customer banks in its press releases (pattern confirmed for other markets), so CZ issuers would surface here if announced.

source_name: ČNB E-ZAK — profil zadavatele České národní banky
why_relevant: ČNB operates CERTIS and the instant-payment rail; its E-ZAK contracting-authority profile is where CERTIS-related IT, HSM, messaging and settlement-infrastructure tenders and award decisions are published first.

source_name: ČNB — CERTIS (pravidla, popis systému, účastníci)
why_relevant: Rule-setter hub for the national clearing and instant-payment rail: rules, annexes, participant lists and technical change announcements that pre-signal vendor work for banks and PSPs.

source_name: ČNB JERRS — seznamy regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map for the payments ecosystem: payment institutions, e-money institutions, small-scale providers — the buyer universe for acquiring/gateway vendor selections. Has WS JERRS web services since 2019.

source_name: Bank iD (Bankovní identita, a.s.) — corporate site
why_relevant: The bank-owned identity aggregator is a distinct buyer and rule-setter; its site carries partner/integrator lists, technical specs and news that reveal vendor selections never published in public registers.

source_name: Sdružení pro bankovní karty (SBK) — bankovnikarty.cz / bankovni-karty.cz
why_relevant: Card-industry association of Czech issuers/acquirers (18 members, 23 observers); its working groups, member/observer lists and conference programmes are a direct map of card-scheme vendors and certification actors.

source_name: Česká bankovní asociace (ČBA) — projects, working groups, COBS standard
why_relevant: ČBA drives sector-wide payment projects (instant payments, open banking) and convenes the working groups where common vendor/standard choices are made before any tender is visible.

source_name: COBS — Czech Standard for Open Banking (GitHub Czech-BA)
why_relevant: Technical repository of the ČBA open-banking standard; commit history, issues and contributor identities expose which banks and which vendor/integrator staff actually build the rails — an indirect vendor-selection signal.

source_name: Global Payments Europe / Global Payments Česko — partner and press pages
why_relevant: Major CZ processor/acquirer (Erste JV heritage); its partner-cooperation and press pages announce bank contracts (e.g. PPF banka card-solution deal) that are never in public registers.

source_name: Worldline Czech Republic — country site and newsroom
why_relevant: Acquiring/processing incumbent in CZ (KB SmartPay alliance with Komerční banka); country newsroom and group press releases carry bank alliance and terminal-estate wins.

source_name: GoPay — blog and help/integration documentation
why_relevant: E-money institution operating a leading CZ gateway; blog and technical docs disclose bank/scheme integrations, new payment-method partners and comparative market structure.

source_name: Twisto — Pro média (press room)
why_relevant: BNPL provider (acquired by Zip); its press room names gateway partners and merchant wins, tracing how BNPL rails get selected into CZ acquiring stacks.

source_name: Mastercard Newsroom — Czech (cs-cz) press releases
why_relevant: Scheme rule-setter publishing CZ-localised releases on tokenisation, instant payments and local partner launches — the visible tip of scheme-driven partner and certification programmes.

source_name: Bankovnipoplatky.cz — payments trade coverage
why_relevant: Czech niche trade outlet that republishes scheme and PSP announcements with local framing; useful as a low-cost tripwire for CZ payments vendor news.

source_name: Státní pokladna — Platební brány a platební terminály
why_relevant: State Treasury rules for how public bodies obtain payment gateways and terminals linked to ČNB-held accounts — defines the procurement channel and eligible providers for the entire public-sector acceptance estate.

source_name: vhodne-uverejneni.cz — profil zadavatele aggregator (incl. ČNB, IČO 48136450)
why_relevant: Third-party certified profile-publishing platform hosting many Czech contracting-authority profiles; a secondary route to notices when E-ZAK/NEN indexes lag or differ.
